answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, slashable deposit in OPAL tokens before it may act, with the stake bonded to a verified identity vertex in a trust graph. Reputation then flows like a ripple through that graph: new agents inherit trust only from endorsements by established peers, so a flood of fake identities gains no standing without costly, attested backing. Sybils become expensive to spin up and easy to prune.
